summary: FURNISHED DOUBLE ROOMS AVAILABLE IN PROFESSIONAL SHARED HOUSE HALF PRICE BONDS Situated near the centre of Hartlepool, we are happy to present these furnished double bedrooms to the market. The property compromises of shared living area, shared kitchen, en-suite rooms available and shared bathrooms. The property is also a great location for some of the large employers in the area such as Strabag, Able and Hartlepool Power Station. - Close to the Marina - Close proximity to the Hospital - Close to Town Centre This property is the perfect location with its close proximity to the above, as well as Shopping, Bars, restaurants and cinema to name a few. All bills are included, including council tax.
